title: You'll live 28,000 days. But only half pay for them.
source_idea:
28,000 DAYS – Video Script
Length: about 75 sec | Vertical 9:16
Voice: calm, warm, like a friend explaining over coffee. Not salesy.
Music: soft piano or lo-fi. Short pause before the 4 questions.

SCENE 1 (0:00–0:04)
Visual: A big counter spins up to 28,000
VO: "You'll live about 28,000 days. But you'll only get paid for half of them."
Text: 28,000 days

SCENE 2 (0:04–0:10)
Visual: A long road splits into 4 blocks: 0–20, 20–40, 40–60, 60–80
VO: "Let's split a life into four parts."
Text: Your life in 4 parts

SCENE 3 (0:10–0:17)
Visual: Alex as a kid playing, then a student with books
VO: "Zero to twenty: you're growing up and studying. No income."
Text: 0–20: No income

SCENE 4 (0:17–0:25)
Visual: Alex at a first job, first car, first home, then a wedding photo
VO: "Twenty to forty: you start earning. First job, first car, maybe a first home and a family."
Text: 20–40: Earning

SCENE 5 (0:25–0:32)
Visual: Alex older: a promotion, a bigger car, kids growing taller
VO: "Forty to sixty: you earn more, upgrade more, and your kids grow up."
Text: 40–60: Earning

SCENE 6 (0:32–0:38)
Visual: Alex retired on a park bench, a piggy bank beside them
VO: "Sixty to eighty: most of us stop working and live on what we saved."
Text: 60–80: Little or no income

SCENE 7 (0:38–0:46)
Visual: The 4 blocks again, only the middle two light up, "14,000" appears
VO: "So about 14,000 working days have to pay for all 28,000. For you, and for your family."
Text: 14,000 days pay for 28,000

SCENE 8 (0:46–0:50)
Visual: Music dips. Alex looks at the camera.
VO: "That raises four questions."
Text: 4 questions

SCENE 9 (0:50–0:54)
Visual: Alex in a hospital bed, money floating out of a wallet
VO: "One: if you get sick, will your hard-earned money go to hospital bills instead of your future?"
Text: 1. If you get sick?

SCENE 10 (0:54–0:58)
Visual: Alex unable to work, a paycheck icon fades away
VO: "Two: if you can't work, does your income stop too?"
Text: 2. If you can't work?

SCENE 11 (0:58–1:02)
Visual: Alex's child in a graduation gown
VO: "Three: will your kids get the education you want for them?"
Text: 3. Your kids' education?

SCENE 12 (1:02–1:06)
Visual: Older Alex on a beach vs older Alex counting coins
VO: "Four: will you retire comfortably, or just retire?"
Text: 4. Your retirement?

SCENE 13 (1:06–1:12)
Visual: The 4 questions as a checklist, two ticked, two empty
VO: "Most people can't tick all four. That's normal. Knowing which one you can't answer is the first step."
Text: Which can you tick?

SCENE 14 (1:12–1:15)
Visual: Simple end card
VO: (none)
Text: For general education only. Not financial advice.

scenes.voice: You'll live about 28,000 days. But you'll only get paid for half of them.
Let's split a life into four parts. From learning, to earning, to retirement.
So about 14,000 working days have to pay for all 28,000. For you, and for your family.
One: if you get sick, will your hard-earned savings go to bills instead of your future?
Two: if you can't work, does your income stop too?
Most people can't tick every box.
scenes.text: Most people can't tick every box.

caption:
Ever wonder how your working years support your whole life?
🗓️
Out of 28,000 days, only about half are spent earning.
